### When to Seek Immediate Emergency Care

Call emergency services right away if chest pain after drinking comes with:

- Pressure, tightness, or squeezing in the center of your chest
- Pain spreading to your arm (especially the left arm), jaw, neck, back, or stomach
- Shortness of breath or trouble breathing
- Sweating, dizziness, lightheadedness, or nausea/vomiting
- A racing, fluttering, or irregular heartbeat[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXX0fuJUPLd5kARkswcTEUXO4EjNkFYf1DFZiuLjdaIBrApmg_p7yO1UWv1zA1G6Mo0Den5vXFdA9QDlBXrNYFmzh8ykX4ExtQ1eibP8IFED9Sg_oNrZxhXgZ19v6YE1ozUQI4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjAEBxCJF1zDhIXJkE-_SIQ5QuWQps2vbGuEex1qlolk57ZWPPKNtTqKmcj9PmcPXmfHOai8dgfV5hagpbaJuAJLUKzHh3zkScc0lqR3R1zRjhw405BNva0PZAK6-i1CYZ7YCvMw9-fJqIZUTKeUrF9D3U8LeyOmg9kCy46KxmmmqVsjmZK7syljK1T4eLA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXKhWgTEeh81ILoqLmreXdF9oSzCC2rL4xzfdRQSLkAqdnrme9Rqom3_nr4dkhsfdn2zbVVfbinjUK33BkNzzgD2cQFTkPyV64mYtQahTxBzJatKneZ1Z0plPiRZ62lGX2)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXTAQi9aIYdSxV_jriVGPWgZ51cvUqcuXzUokTB5vz-WudTNWPPlw3JFMy6hbIlrz6vrIWe1GLAZWxuCHE8qoPN3BppXS2TDYaleTuWOd3eiQRabgQgXCRxB3MNHpy7B-2RBHzjfU)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF1-DIygMAqqZR-0lJn1DJw78OJYJ2-zhv6p6M_OzHRui3dXcjy5FqV696O2JhDzBDB6s5CycF-WoV4Z1ujFDNMZVTumnMt766E1-R-pqdk92xncsm9NSnWlRuoCqWkAfXQRJAZMZkl19_nKcOSa-pIWTQXucJE-3Sha6pzse1ncQNRMnflzu5)[[6]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXHzBvLYX7B6hIabED9xjz-2rl4Zl7WyRrxrmfJFsQNm6W9EtRVYEYM-fmGzex_qbydLHgex_GRs3bTlKmyLDhtp0819hN-duNTzoHD9-DvIafVBKiGWDVXfjze_V5yyyBr01KSZ_j)[[7]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXFPQKRfKyYAW7Hsh0NfzPrIU2blXkzeIGuB5fVd0Q--0oEckPK21U_wExFu2kf2mc0O2aWNXptVIsN9Cd2Wt0WsjyJBiw0CJ4eCnQa5w7tZLv_NyafhZ1f573Trdtg8Mq)

### Common Causes

- **Acid reflux or esophageal irritation:** Alcohol relaxes the lower esophageal sphincter, letting stomach acid irritate the esophagus and cause burning or chest discomfort. Esophageal spasms can also feel like tight or squeezing chest pain.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF12ovifubvbLxcyhLozwqI9mFz7EKy-kRe92zrDeCTDS_NXfJtCzQFgoIbADB6dp2QdykO0kP_aGUxjQufYx0Oll40KRwooYq2EGOZbDtnCQxbdpDlPX8d4AdAT2owXnc6h4027bSPbvGeSlaIaNic050WWypbaqpBbQDSZNYzH1a3WD07JP4Cz2q_Ok)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXX0fuJUPLd5kARkswcTEUXO4EjNkFYf1DFZiuLjdaIBrApmg_p7yO1UWv1zA1G6Mo0Den5vXFdA9QDlBXrNYFmzh8ykX4ExtQ1eibP8IFED9Sg_oNrZxhXgZ19v6YE1ozUQI4)
- **Anxiety or panic ("hangxiety"):** As alcohol wears off, rebound effects on brain chemistry can trigger anxiety or panic attacks, which often cause chest tightness or a fast heart rate.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXX0fuJUPLd5kARkswcTEUXO4EjNkFYf1DFZiuLjdaIBrApmg_p7yO1UWv1zA1G6Mo0Den5vXFdA9QDlBXrNYFmzh8ykX4ExtQ1eibP8IFED9Sg_oNrZxhXgZ19v6YE1ozUQI4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF12ovifubvbLxcyhLozwqI9mFz7EKy-kRe92zrDeCTDS_NXfJtCzQFgoIbADB6dp2QdykO0kP_aGUxjQufYx0Oll40KRwooYq2EGOZbDtnCQxbdpDlPX8d4AdAT2owXnc6h4027bSPbvGeSlaIaNic050WWypbaqpBbQDSZNYzH1a3WD07JP4Cz2q_Ok)
- **Heart rhythm or blood pressure changes:** Alcohol can raise blood pressure and trigger irregular heartbeats—such as atrial fibrillation ("holiday heart syndrome")—or worsen angina (reduced blood flow to the heart). Long-term heavy drinking can also weaken heart muscle (alcoholic cardiomyopathy).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF13gmkl6bt-85jX4X3_hZpj0-CS57N250Oj4QUHQQ661V8jIR35yCAPxXvy6_sBXSi35rb_rrdRgVNbr9fls1g1urspai17x__GPiajV8_uuOKShBsv2icbsLwfVkzoWARR4hVjxl8BgdwDTp8oKloxOSVAPE9-mHTexxOEKq0KEis8mk)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShAEBxCJF13gWdw5Jybyi68Hr4SjRHmPNYzUki8qAIqD1a3QHt_hIQsUS2OZ3oEIvVfqIFFewPGLYBwLzwjF0BYuP-msdWHqMukLBzxyOA6VLVUYdEPrbIGIGHA-WyToEK_mk127ts-_YovODiHJ0TgQH8vcYxAtSxsR9rEIKON_0oDwEuJ8)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXXK5JkvQUjc2taviJTRNlCLiFwi5GB_PU8oTob1wGBJqu4RHjbTpMGRxX8RBTY-xxvwe_2FXWZtvAgkwf428-94tw0lBc1siC97lKDgcBfVQxEaeMLTx9d81Sk8zKfYu8wqnnzTOBdcd96px3yoBDnaLGV)
- **Pancreatitis or stomach irritation:** Alcohol can irritate the stomach lining or inflame the pancreas, causing upper abdominal pain that can radiate toward the chest or back.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShAEBxCJF13gWdw5Jybyi68Hr4SjRHmPNYzUki8qAIqD1a3QHt_hIQsUS2OZ3oEIvVfqIFFewPGLYBwLzwjF0BYuP-msdWHqMukLBzxyOA6VLVUYdEPrbIGIGHA-WyToEK_mk127ts-_YovODiHJ0TgQH8vcYxAtSxsR9rEIKON_0oDwEuJ8)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXX0fuJUPLd5kARkswcTEUXO4EjNkFYf1DFZiuLjdaIBrApmg_p7yO1UWv1zA1G6Mo0Den5vXFdA9QDlBXrNYFmzh8ykX4ExtQ1eibP8IFED9Sg_oNrZxhXgZ19v6YE1ozUQI4)

Opinions on personal experiences also vary. On [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF14IFGe91P47W_Fwt8S22rEJP-kobrYKrI2cdMcUn69qQcY3SOBuqA08e4wkjbdq0soIXJrTdbNRdvzKqHDD9AeBAM8vV4weYoR_nItW86xi1DlVFa8tlrdJM7Hx3tUEtu8zBLonjGMNcB2Ldbh9G9fTKgCjVPAdDDjoq-_BCMcvxXQ) , opinions are mixed: some users say their post-drinking chest pain turns out to be acid reflux or heartburn eased by antacids, while others report discomfort that feels distinct from heartburn and does not respond to reflux remedies. Because heart pain and digestive or anxiety symptoms can feel very similar, a doctor should evaluate recurring or unclear chest pain. You can read more about symptoms and triggers on [Castle Health](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXX0fuJUPLd5kARkswcTEUXO4EjNkFYf1DFZiuLjdaIBrApmg_p7yO1UWv1zA1G6Mo0Den5vXFdA9QDlBXrNYFmzh8ykX4ExtQ1eibP8IFED9Sg_oNrZxhXgZ19v6YE1ozUQI4).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF14IFGe91P47W_Fwt8S22rEJP-kobrYKrI2cdMcUn69qQcY3SOBuqA08e4wkjbdq0soIXJrTdbNRdvzKqHDD9AeBAM8vV4weYoR_nItW86xi1DlVFa8tlrdJM7Hx3tUEtu8zBLonjGMNcB2Ldbh9G9fTKgCjVPAdDDjoq-_BCMcvxXQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXX0fuJUPLd5kARkswcTEUXO4EjNkFYf1DFZiuLjdaIBrApmg_p7yO1UWv1zA1G6Mo0Den5vXFdA9QDlBXrNYFmzh8ykX4ExtQ1eibP8IFED9Sg_oNrZxhXgZ19v6YE1ozUQI4)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXXK5JkvQUjc2taviJTRNlCLiFwi5GB_PU8oTob1wGBJqu4RHjbTpMGRxX8RBTY-xxvwe_2FXWZtvAgkwf428-94tw0lBc1siC97lKDgcBfVQxEaeMLTx9d81Sk8zKfYu8wqnnzTOBdcd96px3yoBDnaLGV)Are you experiencing this **right now** , or asking about **past episodes** ? Sharing **what the pain feels like** (burning, sharp, tight) and **any other symptoms** can help me provide more tailored information.

items.text: Acid reflux or esophageal irritation: Alcohol relaxes the lower esophageal sphincter, letting stomach acid irritate the esophagus and cause burning or chest discomfort. Esophageal spasms can also feel like tight or squeezing chest pain. Anxiety or panic ("hangxiety"): As alcohol wears off, rebound effects on brain chemistry can trigger anxiety or panic attacks, which often cause chest tightness or a fast heart rate. Heart rhythm or blood pressure changes: Alcohol can raise blood pressure and trigger irregular heartbeats—such as atrial fibrillation ("holiday heart syndrome")—or worsen angina (reduced blood flow to the heart). Long-term heavy drinking can also weaken heart muscle (alcoholic cardiomyopathy). Pancreatitis or stomach irritation: Alcohol can irritate the stomach lining or inflame the pancreas, causing upper abdominal pain that can radiate toward the chest or back.

Because heart pain and digestive or anxiety symptoms can feel very similar, a doctor should evaluate recurring or unclear chest pain. You can read more about symptoms and triggers on [Castle Health](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXX0fuJUPLd5kARkswcTEUXO4EjNkFYf1DFZiuLjdaIBrApmg_p7yO1UWv1zA1G6Mo0Den5vXFdA9QDlBXrNYFmzh8ykX4ExtQ1eibP8IFED9Sg_oNrZxhXgZ19v6YE1ozUQI4).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF14IFGe91P47W_Fwt8S22rEJP-kobrYKrI2cdMcUn69qQcY3SOBuqA08e4wkjbdq0soIXJrTdbNRdvzKqHDD9AeBAM8vV4weYoR_nItW86xi1DlVFa8tlrdJM7Hx3tUEtu8zBLonjGMNcB2Ldbh9G9fTKgCjVPAdDDjoq-_BCMcvxXQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXX0fuJUPLd5kARkswcTEUXO4EjNkFYf1DFZiuLjdaIBrApmg_p7yO1UWv1zA1G6Mo0Den5vXFdA9QDlBXrNYFmzh8ykX4ExtQ1eibP8IFED9Sg_oNrZxhXgZ19v6YE1ozUQI4)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXXK5JkvQUjc2taviJTRNlCLiFwi5GB_PU8oTob1wGBJqu4RHjbTpMGRxX8RBTY-xxvwe_2FXWZtvAgkwf428-94tw0lBc1siC97lKDgcBfVQxEaeMLTx9d81Sk8zKfYu8wqnnzTOBdcd96px3yoBDnaLGV)
